evidence.description: Incident report 25-087152, dated Wednesday, March 5, 2025, approximately 02:00, restaurant premises, Southeast Rochester, MN. Officers met the reporting party at the scene.
Shows a person in a face mask and gloves getting out of a vehicle and entering the building.
Silver or tan Toyota Tundra pickup with no front plate, a dimmer passenger-side headlight and a rolled-up bed cover, arriving just before 2 a.m.
Front window broken and the ATM in the entryway pried at; about $1,500 in damage to the ATM.
Tire track left at the scene; a photo of the pickup's tire tread was to be compared to it (result not stated).
Before the break-in, a person resembling the later suspect drove a similar vehicle to the restaurant and photographed the pull-tab machines.
